description: This file contains handlers and utility functions for managing tool execution lifecycle events (start, update, end) within an agent framework, including tracking, emitting events, handling messaging tools, and integrating plugin hooks.

methods.name: buildToolStartKey
methods.description: Constructs a unique key for tracking tool start data based on run ID and tool call ID.

methods.name: isCronAddAction
methods.description: Checks if the provided arguments indicate a cron add action.

methods.name: buildToolCallSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary object for a tool call, including mutation state and action fingerprint.

methods.name: extendExecMeta
methods.description: Extends tool execution metadata with flags like 'pty' and 'elevated' based on args.

methods.name: pushUniqueMediaUrl
methods.description: Adds a media URL to the list if it is a unique, non-empty string.

methods.name: collectMessagingMediaUrlsFromRecord
methods.description: Collects media URLs from a record, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: collectMessagingMediaUrlsFromToolResult
methods.description: Extracts media URLs from a tool result, including nested details and JSON output.

methods.name: queuePendingToolMedia
methods.description: Queues media URLs for later processing, marking if audio should be played as voice.

methods.name: readExecApprovalPendingDetails
methods.description: Parses and returns details of an approval pending result.

methods.name: readExecApprovalUnavailableDetails
methods.description: Parses and returns details of an approval unavailable result.

methods.name: emitToolResultOutput
methods.description: Handles emitting the output of a tool result, including approval prompts, media, and errors.

methods.name: handleToolExecutionStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a tool execution, tracking start time, args, and emitting start events.

methods.name: handleToolExecutionUpdate
methods.description: Handles partial updates during tool execution, emitting update events.

methods.name: handleToolExecutionEnd
methods.description: Handles completion of a tool execution, processing results, errors, media, and plugin hooks.
